# CommandBar

Header: `winui/ui/menus/CommandBar.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/menus/CommandBar.hpp`.

A toolbar of app-bar buttons with an overflow menu behind a More ("...") button.

Primary commands ([AppBarButton](app-bar-button.md#uiappbarbutton), [AppBarToggleButton](app-bar-button.md#uiappbartogglebutton), [AppBarSeparator](app-bar-button.md#uiappbarseparator), or any [Element](../tree/element.md)) sit in a row against the bar's right edge, with optional content on the left. Secondary commands are in the overflow menu. Opening the bar with the More button or [set_open()](#set_open) shows the overflow menu and the text of commands whose text goes at the Bottom. The open bar is drawn over whatever lies below it, or above it when it opens upward, and never moves other elements. A click on a command closes the bar, and so does a click outside or Escape unless [is_sticky()](#is_sticky). With dynamic overflow on (the default), primary commands that do not fit move into the overflow and come back when there is room. The shortcuts of secondary commands fire app-wide while the bar is in the window.

Example: 
```cpp
auto  bar     = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarControl>();
auto* add     = bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Add", ui::Symbol::Add));
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarSeparatorControl>());
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarToggleButtonControl>("Shuffle", ui::Symbol::Shuffle));
auto* settings = bar->add_secondary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Settings", ui::Symbol::Setting));
bar->set_content(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Now playing"));
bar->set_default_text_position(ui::CommandBarDefaultTextPosition::Right);
add->on_click([] { /* add an item */ });
settings->on_click([] { /* open settings */ });
window.set_content(std::move(bar));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .default_text_position = ui::CommandBarDefaultTextPosition::Right,
    .content   = ui::Text{.text = "Now playing", .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Center},
    .primary   = {ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Add", .icon = ui::Symbol::Add},
                  ui::AppBarSeparator{},
                  ui::AppBarToggleButton{.text = "Shuffle", .icon = ui::Symbol::Shuffle}},
    .secondary = {ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Settings", .icon = ui::Symbol::Setting}},
});
```

## `ui::CommandBar`

A toolbar of app-bar buttons with an overflow menu. Builds a [ui::CommandBarControl](#uicommandbarcontrol).

Primary commands sit in the bar, and secondary commands are in the overflow menu behind the More ("...") button. With dynamic overflow on, primary commands that do not fit move into the overflow too. Opening the bar with the More button shows the text and the overflow.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> status;
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .default_text_position = ui::CommandBarDefaultTextPosition::Right,
    .on_closed              = [&](ui::PopupCloseReason) { status = "closed"; },
    .content                = ui::Text{ .text = "Now playing", .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Center },
    .primary   = { ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Add", .icon = ui::Symbol::Add, .on_click = [&] { status = "new"; } },
                   ui::AppBarSeparator{},
                   ui::AppBarToggleButton{ .text = "Shuffle", .icon = ui::Symbol::Shuffle } },
    .secondary = { ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Settings", .icon = ui::Symbol::Setting } },
});
```

```cpp
ui::CommandBar{
    .is_open, .sticky, .default_text_position, .overflow_button_visibility,
    .dynamic_overflow_enabled, .closed_display_mode, .background, .style, .margin, .width,
    .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_opening,
    .on_opened, .on_closing, .on_closed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited,
    .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content, .primary,
    .secondary
}
```

Primary commands ([AppBarButton](app-bar-button.md#uiappbarbutton), [AppBarToggleButton](app-bar-button.md#uiappbartogglebutton), [AppBarSeparator](app-bar-button.md#uiappbarseparator), or any [Element](../tree/element.md)) sit in a row against the bar's right edge, with optional content on the left. ### CommandBarControl

```cpp
CommandBarControl()
```

An empty, closed, Compact bar with the More button on Auto.

### ~CommandBarControl

```cpp
~CommandBarControl() override
```

Destroys every command, the content and the overflow.

### add_primary

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add_primary(std::unique_ptr<T> command)
```

Appends `command` to the row. Takes ownership and hands back a non-owning observer (the same convention as [StackControl::add()](../layout/stack.md#add)). Updates the layout.

### add_secondary

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add_secondary(std::unique_ptr<T> command)
```

Appends `command` to the overflow menu. Takes ownership and hands back a non-owning observer. Updates the layout.

### insert_primary_element

```cpp
void insert_primary_element(std::size_t index, std::unique_ptr<Element> command)
```

Inserts a primary command before `index` (clamped to the end), taking ownership. `command` must not be null. Updates the layout.

### insert_secondary_element

```cpp
void insert_secondary_element(std::size_t index, std::unique_ptr<Element> command)
```

Inserts a secondary command before `index` (clamped to the end), taking ownership. `command` must not be null. Updates the layout.

### remove_primary

```cpp
void remove_primary(std::size_t index)
```

Destroys the primary command at `index`; out of range is ignored. Updates the layout.

### remove_secondary

```cpp
void remove_secondary(std::size_t index)
```

Destroys the secondary command at `index`; out of range is ignored. Updates the layout.

```cpp
std::size_t primary_count() const
```

```cpp
std::size_t secondary_count() const
```

```cpp
Element* primary(std::size_t index) const
```

```cpp
Element* secondary(std::size_t index) const
```

### set_content

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_content(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Shows [`content`](#content) at the bar's left, replacing any previous content; null clears it. Takes ownership and hands back a non-owning observer. Hidden while closed in Minimal/Hidden.

### content

```cpp
Element* content() const
```

The content as a non-owning observer, or nullptr.

### default_text_position

```cpp
CommandBarDefaultTextPosition default_text_position() const
```

Where every command puts its text. Bottom (the default) shows the text only while the bar is open, Right always beside the icon, Collapsed never.

### set_default_text_position

```cpp
void set_default_text_position(CommandBarDefaultTextPosition position)
```

Sets where every command puts its text, and lays out every command again.

### is_open

```cpp
bool is_open() const
```

Whether the bar is lifted over its surroundings, with the text and the overflow showing. False by default.

### set_open

```cpp
void set_open(bool open)
```

Opens or closes the bar. Fires [on_opening()](#on_opening)/on_closing() at once and [on_opened()](#on_opened)/ [on_closed()](#on_closed) once the transition has run; no-op when unchanged.

### closed_display_mode

```cpp
AppBarClosedDisplayMode closed_display_mode() const
```

What the closed bar shows; Compact by default.

### set_closed_display_mode

```cpp
void set_closed_display_mode(AppBarClosedDisplayMode mode)
```

Sets what the closed bar shows and updates the layout. The closed height is 48, 24 or 0 DIPs.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(Paint color)
```

The fill behind the bar, closed and open: a fixed color or a theme resource. Empty, the default, is transparent. In Compact mode the open bar draws its acrylic over this fill.

### open_rect

```cpp
Rect open_rect() const
```

Where the open bar is drawn: over the closed bar and whatever lies below it, or above it when it opens upward. It takes no room in the layout, and the bar's [bounds()](../tree/element.md#bounds) stay those of the closed bar.

### opens_up

```cpp
bool opens_up() const
```

Whether the open bar went up because there was not enough room below for it and its overflow.

### is_sticky

```cpp
bool is_sticky() const
```

Whether light dismiss is off, so an outside click or Escape leaves the bar open.

### set_sticky

```cpp
void set_sticky(bool sticky)
```

False by default. A click on a command still closes a sticky bar.

### overflow_button_visibility

```cpp
AutoVisibility overflow_button_visibility() const
```

When the More button shows. Auto, the default, shows it only when there is something to reveal: overflow entries or hidden text. With Collapsed, the pointer cannot reach the secondary commands.

### set_overflow_button_visibility

```cpp
void set_overflow_button_visibility(AutoVisibility visibility)
```

Updates the layout.

### is_dynamic_overflow_enabled

```cpp
bool is_dynamic_overflow_enabled() const
```

Whether dynamic overflow is on; true by default. When the bar is narrower than its commands, primary commands move into the overflow and move back when there is room. The group with the lowest dynamic_overflow_order() moves first, then the rest from the right.

### set_dynamic_overflow_enabled

```cpp
void set_dynamic_overflow_enabled(bool enabled)
```

Updates the layout.

### is_primary_in_overflow

```cpp
bool is_primary_in_overflow(std::size_t index) const
```

Whether the primary command at `index` has been moved into the overflow by dynamic overflow.

### more_button_visible

```cpp
bool more_button_visible() const
```

Whether the More button shows, resolving [overflow_button_visibility()](#overflow_button_visibility)'s Auto against the current commands, closed mode and text position.

### on_opening

```cpp
void on_opening(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired as [is_open()](#is_open) turns true, before the transition. Replaces any previous handler.

### on_opened

```cpp
void on_opened(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired once the opening transition has run.

### on_closing

```cpp
void on_closing(Callback<Decision(const PopupClosingArgs&)> handler)
```

Fired before [is_open()](#is_open) turns false, with why: Programmatic for set_open(false), LightDismiss for a click outside or Escape, Invoked for a command click, CloseButton for the More button. Return [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to keep the bar open.

### on_closed

```cpp
void on_closed(Callback<void(PopupCloseReason)> handler)
```

Fired once the closing transition has run, with the reason [on_closing()](#on_closing) saw. This is where a bound [`is_open`](#is_open) learns about a light dismiss.

### command_invoked

```cpp
void command_invoked(CommandBarElement& command) override
```

A command in the bar was clicked, so the bar closes.

### toggle_from_more_button

```cpp
void toggle_from_more_button()
```

The More button was clicked, or Down/Up pressed on it: toggles the bar, and an opening moves keyboard focus into the overflow.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Lists the shown row in drawing order (the content, the primaries left in the bar, the More button), which is what [Tab](tabs.md#uitab) and automation walk. A closed bar in Minimal or Hidden mode leaves out the content and the primaries, and Hidden leaves out the More button too.

### sync_native

```cpp
void sync_native(NativeHost& host) override
```

Passes native-control hosting on to the content only.

### handle_global_shortcut

```cpp
bool handle_global_shortcut(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

The shortcuts of the overflow's commands, which fire whether or not the overflow is open.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Always AutomationRole::ToolBar.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The closed bar's size, with a height of 48, 24 or 0 DIPs. Also decides which primary commands move into the overflow at the available width.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places the content, the primaries left in the bar and the More button.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the closed bar; the open bar is drawn over the tree by the window's popup layer.

### hit_test_children

```cpp
void hit_test_children(Point p, std::vector<Element*>& out) const override
```

The commands, while the bar is closed.

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

Clears `flags` on this node and every owned child, shown or not: the secondaries, the separator, the open-bar layer and the overflow too.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Ticks the content and every command, shown or not, and the More button, then runs the open/close transition.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

## Enumerations

### AppBarClosedDisplayMode

```cpp
enum class AppBarClosedDisplayMode
```

What a closed [CommandBar](#uicommandbar) shows.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Compact` | the icons, 48 tall |
| `Minimal` | the More button only, 24 tall |
| `Hidden` | nothing, 0 tall |
